detail: An older, wider release of Peacekeeping/data/pk&pkept.dta: the same time-varying spells per ceasefire id under conflict clusters (cluster, clust2), with the Cox fit's predicted hazards and Schoenfeld and Pearson residuals appended; the current release is re-filed into the registry.

A ceasefire-level reduction of Peacekeeping/data/pk&pkept.dta (the same cfdate and faildate as day counts, delay in years, badness an index), one row per ceasefire with the conflict name (Unnamed: 0) repeating across a conflict's ceasefires; ROS plots it and fits no model on it.
identical to ros:Beauty/data/beauty.csv, which the registry holds

The raw Stata source (41,498 rows) of the rpackage nes, which NES/data/nes_setup.R restricts to complete age, income and state and extends by race_adj and age_discrete; nes is re-filed into the registry.
